test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

The inflow of foreign portfolio funds into Indian equities have pushed up price-earning multiples and valuation.

options.text: The inflow of foreign portfolio funds

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• The part of the sentence that contains a **grammatical error** is:** into Indian equities have pushed.**
 
• The **error in this sentence is related to **subject-verb agreement.
 
• The **subject of the sentence** "The inflow of foreign portfolio funds" is** singular**.
 
• Therefore, it should be **followed by **a **singular verb** "has" **instead of the** plural "have".

Therefore, the** corrected sentence** is: *"The inflow of foreign portfolio funds** into Indian equities has pushed **up price-earning multiples and valuation."*
